used_when: data/draduck.json {"wake": "nee4"}; lab trial model of 2026-11-24, not installed on a duck yet, not the default

trainer.name: livekit-wakeword
trainer.note: Same commit and frontends as xiaoya.onnx. Steps after augmentation were run by draduck_wakeword/train_steps.py, because run_extraction needs SessionOptions at this commit.

data.positives: the nee positives plus MiniMax speech-2.8-turbo voices: 15 Japanese, 32 Mandarin (the Japanese phrase with language boost Japanese and auto, and four Chinese-character spellings of how a Mandarin speaker says it; the list is in the generator), 12 English, 10 Korean; 3614 train / 738 test, test voices held out
data.negatives: the nee3 negatives plus MiniMax 「ねえ、…」 near misses (ねえ、ドラマ見た？ / ねえ、トラック来たよ / ねえ、ドラゴン / ねえ、どら焼き食べる？ and 16 more) and Mandarin everyday sentences with similar sounds, in the Japanese, Mandarin and English voices; 11332 train / 2045 test

evaluation.held_out_voices_2026_11_24: at 0.35 (clean): Mandarin 89% (nee 49%, nee3 92%), English 89% (61%, 86%), Japanese 100% (96%, 100%), Korean 96% (100%, 96%); old test positives 100%
evaluation.near_misses_2026_11_24: held-out voices at 0.35 (clean): wakes on 8% of the Japanese 「ねえ、…」 near-miss clips (nee 0%, nee3 14%), 0.7% of the Mandarin ones (0%, 4.5%), 2.0% of the old negatives (nee3 2.1%)
evaluation.stream_test_2026_11_24: ねえ、ドラダック 29/30, ドラダック alone 3-4/30, 0 false wakes in 7.6 min family talk, 1 in 3.8 min packed near misses at 0.3-0.5
evaluation.known_problem: still wakes on 「ねえ、ドラマ見た？」「ねえ、トラック来たよ」「ねえ、ドラゴン」 in some voices; livekit false wakes per hour 1.18 at 0.5 (its validation set holds the new near misses); not a shipping default until it matches nee there. Real voices through the duck microphone are still missing from training
